data.name: Adam
data.title: The First Man
data.description: The first human being, created by God in His own image.
data.scripture_text: When Adam was 130 years old, he became the father of a son who was just like him—in his very image. He named his son Seth.

data.name: Seth
data.title: Son of Adam
data.description: The third son of Adam and Eve, born after the death of Abel.
data.scripture_text: When Seth was 105 years old, he became the father of Enosh.

data.name: Enosh
data.title: Son of Seth
data.description: Son of Seth; in his time, people first began to worship the Lord by name.
data.scripture_text: When Enosh was 90 years old, he became the father of Kenan.

data.name: Kenan
data.title: Son of Enosh
data.description: Son of Enosh and a grandson of Seth.
data.scripture_text: When Kenan was 70 years old, he became the father of Mahalalel.

data.name: Mahalalel
data.title: Son of Kenan
data.description: The son of Kenan and father of Jared.
data.scripture_text: When Mahalalel was 65 years old, he became the father of Jared.

data.name: Jared
data.title: Son of Mahalalel
data.description: The son of Mahalalel and father of Enoch.
data.scripture_text: When Jared was 162 years old, he became the father of Enoch.

data.name: Enoch
data.title: One Who Walked with God
data.description: A man who walked faithfully with God and was taken by God without dying.
data.scripture_text: When Enoch was 65 years old, he became the father of Methuselah.

data.name: Methuselah
data.title: Longest Living Man
data.description: The son of Enoch and the person with the longest lifespan recorded in the Bible.
data.scripture_text: When Methuselah was 187 years old, he became the father of Lamech.

data.name: Lamech
data.title: Son of Methuselah
data.description: The son of Methuselah and father of Noah.
data.scripture_text: When Lamech was 182 years old, he became the father of a son. He named him Noah, for he said, 'May he bring us relief from our work and the painful labor of farming this ground that the Lord has cursed.'

data.name: Noah
data.title: Builder of the Ark
data.description: The righteous man who built an ark to save his family and animals from the Great Flood.
data.scripture_text: After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

data.name: Shem
data.title: Son of Noah
data.description: One of the three sons of Noah and the ancestor of the Semitic peoples.
data.scripture_text: This is the account of Shem’s family. Two years after the great flood, when Shem was 100 years old, he became the father of Arphaxad.

data.name: Arphaxad
data.title: Son of Shem
data.description: The son of Shem, born two years after the Great Flood.
data.scripture_text: When Arphaxad was 35 years old, he became the father of Shelah.

data.name: Shelah
data.title: Son of Arphaxad
data.description: The son of Arphaxad and father of Eber.
data.scripture_text: When Shelah was 30 years old, he became the father of Eber.

data.name: Eber
data.title: Ancestor of the Hebrews
data.description: The son of Shelah and the person from whom the name 'Hebrew' is often thought to be derived.
data.scripture_text: When Eber was 34 years old, he became the father of Peleg.

data.name: Peleg
data.title: Son of Eber
data.description: Son of Eber; during his lifetime the earth was divided.
data.scripture_text: When Peleg was 30 years old, he became the father of Reu.

data.name: Reu
data.title: Son of Peleg
data.description: The son of Peleg and father of Serug.
data.scripture_text: When Reu was 32 years old, he became the father of Serug.

data.name: Serug
data.title: Son of Reu
data.description: The son of Reu and father of Nahor.
data.scripture_text: When Serug was 30 years old, he became the father of Nahor.

data.name: Nahor
data.title: Son of Serug
data.description: The son of Serug and father of Terah.
data.scripture_text: When Nahor was 29 years old, he became the father of Terah.

data.name: Terah
data.title: Father of Abraham
data.description: The son of Nahor who moved his family from Ur of the Chaldeans toward Canaan.
data.scripture_text: After Terah was 70 years old, he became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

data.name: Abraham
data.title: Father of Many Nations
data.description: Originally named Abram, he was called by God to leave his home and become the father of a great nation.
data.scripture_text: The Lord had said to Abram, 'Leave your native country, your relatives, and your father’s family, and go to the land that I will show you.'
